# DEC Towers

> DEC Towers is a residential and retail complex in Dubai Marina, made up of two towers of twenty-one and twenty-six storeys linked by a five-storey podium. It contains 417 apartments, comprising 151 studios, 182 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and eight three-bedroom homes, together with twelve retail units at ground level. Completed in 2008, it sits a short walk from the marina promenade and Marina Beach.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2008

## MENASCO Scope

DEC Towers is a residential and retail development in Dubai Marina, developed by Dheeraj & East Coast. The complex comprises two residential towers linked by a five-storey podium, offering studio to three-bedroom apartments with retail units at ground level. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the development for Dheeraj & East Coast, with AEIB as consultant.
